svg.title: Raspberry Pi: connect before enclosing
svg.desc: Power supply → Raspberry Pi 4 USB-C: Use a suitable 5 V / 3 A supply; fit the prepared microSD card. Pi micro-HDMI → display HDMI: Carries the picture to the Waveshare 7.9-inch screen. Pi USB → display TOUCH connection: Carries touch data and can power the display; see the vendor power guide. Check the desktop and touch together: Rotate to 1280 × 400 landscape, then verify touch alignment. Install the ocean, then assemble the enclosure: Test first; print one case and two legs; keep ventilation clear

g.text: Connection guide, not a port-location drawing or electrical pinout.
Use a suitable 5 V / 3 A supply; fit the prepared microSD card
Carries the picture to the Waveshare 7.9-inch screen
Carries touch data and can power the display; see the vendor power guide
Check the desktop and touch together
Rotate to 1280 × 400 landscape, then verify touch alignment
Install the ocean, then assemble the enclosure
Test first; print one case and two legs; keep ventilation clear
If power is unstable, check cables and the manufacturer’s separate-power arrangement.
